project_info.title: Comprehensive Analysis of Brazilian Legislative Dataset: Temporal Evolution, Geographic Diffusion, and Transport Policy Innovation (1942-2025)

data_description.source: LexML Portal - Brazilian Legal Document Repository

methodology.data_cleaning: CSV corruption repair, encoding standardization, URN validation
methodology.text_processing: Portuguese legal NLP, domain-specific stopwords, transport theme classification
methodology.temporal_analysis: Constitutional era analysis, decade-level trends, policy evolution tracking
methodology.geospatial_analysis: State-level policy diffusion, regional innovation patterns, municipal analysis
methodology.network_analysis: URN-based citations, legal cross-references, authority citation patterns
methodology.quality_control: Multi-level validation, completeness scoring, text quality assessment

research_applications.policy_evolution: Tracking legislative development across constitutional eras
research_applications.geographic_diffusion: Modeling policy innovation spread across Brazilian states
research_applications.text_mining: Legal terminology evolution and domain analysis
research_applications.citation_networks: Policy influence and legal precedent tracking
